summary:
Voices from Space is an educational digital storytelling project inspired by NASA missions and equipment left on the Moon and Mars. It explores the stories of four missions: Surveyor 3, Opportunity, Spirit, and Ingenuity. Our team developed a six-chapter adventure story featuring fictional characters who discover the history, challenges, and scientific contributions of these real space missions.

The project includes an interactive HTML storybook with a space-themed design and navigation controls that allow readers to move between pages. Its purpose is to make space exploration more accessible and engaging, especially for students. Through storytelling and digital technology, we aim to show that even when space equipment stops working, its scientific legacy is not forgotten.

The story is divided into six chapters and combines scientific information with fictional characters, dialogue, and adventure. The interactive book was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, featuring a space-themed visual design, page-turning animations, and navigation controls.

The main benefit of this project is making space exploration easier to understand through an engaging educational experience. Its creative approach combines real NASA mission information with storytelling and digital technology to help students appreciate the scientific legacy of these missions.
